question: Why does the assembly of great herbs bow to the moon-crested lord?
premises: The group of great herbs bows in reverence.
The lord bears the moon as his crest.
The lord is described with a garland of the kali age.
inference: Even the realm of great herbs honors the lord who bears cosmic and temporal insignia.
plain_english: O lord, the assembly of great herbs bows to you, who wear the moon as your crest and bear the garland of the age of Kali.
